items.title: Microsoft Releases Emergency Patch For Windows Server Update Service RCE Vulnerability
items.description: Microsoft has rolled out an out-of-band emergency patch for a remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability affecting the Windows Server Update Services (WSUS).
